description: 覆盖 Wiley 通用稿件、利益冲突、数据可用性和投稿材料要素，并提示期刊差异。
descriptionEn: Covers common Wiley manuscript, competing-interest, data-availability, and submission-material elements while flagging journal-level differences.

submissionElements.label: 论文标题
submissionElements.description: 核对标题与文章类型及期刊风格一致。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify that the title matches the article type and journal style.

submissionElements.label: 作者与单位
submissionElements.description: 核对作者姓名、单位、通讯作者和必要标识符。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify author names, affiliations, corresponding author, and required identifiers.

submissionElements.label: 摘要
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify the abstract structure and word limit.

submissionElements.label: 关键词
submissionElements.description: 核对关键词数量和期刊词表要求。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify keyword count and journal vocabulary requirements.

submissionElements.label: 利益冲突声明
submissionElements.description: 核对声明内容和期刊要求的标题。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify the statement content and journal-required heading.

submissionElements.label: 数据可用性声明
submissionElements.description: 核对数据共享政策、位置和访问条件。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify data-sharing policy, location, and access conditions.

submissionElements.label: 资助声明
submissionElements.description: 核对资助来源和项目编号。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify funding sources and grant identifiers.

submissionElements.label: 伦理与同意
submissionElements.description: 核对伦理批准、参与者同意和发表同意。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify ethics approval, participant consent, and consent for publication.

submissionElements.label: 作者贡献声明
submissionElements.description: 核对作者贡献说明和责任确认。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify author contributions and responsibility confirmation.

submissionElements.label: 投稿附信
submissionElements.description: 核对期刊是否要求附信及其指定内容。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify whether the journal requires a cover letter and specified content.

submissionElements.label: 图表与题注
submissionElements.description: 核对文件格式、题注和正文引用。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify file formats, captions, and in-text citations.

submissionElements.label: 补充材料
submissionElements.description: 核对补充材料格式、命名和引用。
submissionElements.descriptionEn: Verify supplementary-material format, naming, and citations.

rules.message: 请确认利益冲突声明及其标题符合所选 Wiley 期刊要求。
rules.messageEn: Confirm that the competing-interest statement and heading meet the selected Wiley journal's requirements.

rules.message: 请确认数据可用性声明及其标题符合所选 Wiley 期刊要求。
rules.messageEn: Confirm that the data-availability statement and heading meet the selected Wiley journal's requirements.

rules.message: 请核对具体 Wiley 期刊的作者指南、文章类型和补充材料要求。
rules.messageEn: Check the selected Wiley journal's author guidelines, article type, and supporting-information requirements.
